content.key_finding: 必须使用 client.enums 获取枚举值，不能直接导入枚举类

# 正确方式：使用 client.enums 获取枚举值
campaign.contains_eu_political_advertising = client.enums.EuPoliticalAdvertisingStatusEnum.DOES_NOT_CONTAIN_EU_POLITICAL_ADVERTISING

content.code_example_search_campaign:
def create_search_campaign(client, customer_id, budget_resource_name):
    campaign_operation = client.get_type('CampaignOperation')
    campaign = campaign_operation.create
    campaign.name = f'Campaign #{uuid4()}'
    campaign.advertising_channel_type = client.enums.AdvertisingChannelTypeEnum.SEARCH
    campaign.status = client.enums.CampaignStatusEnum.PAUSED
    campaign.campaign_budget = budget_resource_name
    campaign.contains_eu_political_advertising = client.enums.EuPoliticalAdvertisingStatusEnum.DOES_NOT_CONTAIN_EU_POLITICAL_ADVERTISING
    response = campaign_service.mutate_campaigns(customer_id=customer_id, operations=[campaign_operation])
    return response.results[0].resource_name

content.description: Google Ads Performance Max (PMax) 广告系列创建流程

required_fields.name: 广告系列名称
required_fields.campaign_budget: CampaignBudget 资源名（使用 Temporary ID）
required_fields.maximize_conversion_value: Bidding 策略（不使用 bidding_strategy 字段）
required_fields.brand_guidelines_enabled: 品牌指南开关（可设为 False 避免需要 Brand Assets）

special_requirements: PMax 不需要 AdGroup，需要 Asset Group（通过 AssetGroupService 创建）
不需要 Bidding Strategy，直接使用 maximize_conversion_value 或 maximize_conversions 字段
Brand Guidelines 启用时需要 BUSINESS_NAME 和 LOGO asset
需要 Merchant Center 账户
必须使用 Temporary IDs 在同一 Mutate 请求中创建所有实体
content.code_example:
# 关键：不使用 bidding_strategy 字段
# 使用 maximize_conversion_value 或 maximize_conversions

def create_pmax_campaign(client, customer_id, merchant_center_id, brand_guidelines_enabled=False):
    # Temporary IDs
    _BUDGET_TEMPORARY_ID = '-1'
    _CAMPAIGN_TEMPORARY_ID = '-2'
    _ASSET_GROUP_TEMPORARY_ID = '-3'
    
    # Step 1: Create Budget
    budget_operation = client.get_type('MutateOperation')
    budget = budget_operation.campaign_budget_operation.create
    budget.name = 'PMax Budget'
    budget.amount_micros = 50000000
    budget.explicitly_shared = False
    budget.resource_name = client.get_service('CampaignBudgetService').campaign_budget_path(
        customer_id, _BUDGET_TEMPORARY_ID
    )
    
    # Step 2: Create Campaign
    campaign_operation = client.get_type('MutateOperation')
    campaign = campaign_operation.campaign_operation.create
    campaign.name = f'PMax Campaign #{uuid4()}'
    campaign.status = client.enums.CampaignStatusEnum.PAUSED
    campaign.advertising_channel_type = client.enums.AdvertisingChannelTypeEnum.PERFORMANCE_MAX
    
    # ✅ 关键：设置 Bidding（不使用 bidding_strategy）
    campaign.maximize_conversion_value.target_roas = None  # 不设 ROAS
    # 或
    # campaign.maximize_conversions.target_cpa_micros = None
    
    # Brand Guidelines
    campaign.brand_guidelines_enabled = brand_guidelines_enabled
    
    # Shopping Setting
    campaign.shopping_setting.merchant_id = merchant_center_id
    
    # Resource Name
    campaign.resource_name = client.get_service('CampaignService').campaign_path(
        customer_id, _CAMPAIGN_TEMPORARY_ID
    )
    campaign.campaign_budget = budget.resource_name
    
    # EU Political Advertising
    campaign.contains_eu_political_advertising = 
        client.enums.EuPoliticalAdvertisingStatusEnum.DOES_NOT_CONTAIN_EU_POLITICAL_ADVERTISING
    
    # Execute Mutate
    response = client.get_service('GoogleAdsService').mutate(
        customer_id=customer_id,
        mutate_operations=[budget_operation, campaign_operation]
    )
    return response.results[-1].resource_name

error_analysis.root_cause: 账户缺少 MAXIMIZE_CONVERSIONS 类型的 Bidding Strategy
error_analysis.clarification: PMax Campaign 不需要 Bidding Strategy 资源，直接使用 maximize_conversion_value/maximize_conversions 字段

sdk_issue.problem: 旧代码尝试创建 Bidding Strategy 资源，但 PMax 不支持 Portfolio Bidding
sdk_issue.evidence: 错误信息：The required field was not present (scheme)
sdk_issue.solution: 删除 bidding_strategy 字段，改用 maximize_conversion_value.target_roas = None

code_issues: campaign.advertising_channel_sub_type 不应设置（PMax 固定）
campaign.bidding_strategy 字段不应使用（PMax 使用 maximize_conversion_value）
error_analysis.network_issue: 无 - Google Ads API 可正常访问（Shopping Campaign 已成功创建）

account_issue.problem: 现有 Bidding Strategy 类型为 UNKNOWN，PMax 需要 MAXIMIZE_CONVERSIONS 类型
account_issue.solution: 在 Google Ads 界面或 DAP 系统创建 MAXIMIZE_CONVERSIONS 类型 Bidding Strategy

solution: ✅ Google Ads API 网络正常（Shopping Campaign 已验证成功）
方案 1: 使用 DAP 系统创建 PMax Campaign（推荐）
- Bidding Strategy 选择: Maximize conversions
方案 2: 手动在 Google Ads 界面创建 Bidding Strategy
- 创建 MAXIMIZE_CONVERSIONS 类型 Bidding Strategy
- 获取 Resource Name 后再通过 API 创建 Campaign
方案 3: 设置 Brand Guidelines = False（快速启动）
- 避免需要 Brand Assets（BUSINESS_NAME + LOGO）
- 后续可通过 UI 添加 Brand Assets

content.description: Google Ads Shopping 广告系列创建流程

required_fields.shopping_setting.merchant_id: 有效的 Merchant Center ID（需要先在界面创建链接）
required_fields.shopping_setting.campaign_priority: 整数 0-100，表示 Campaign 优先级

shopping_setting_required.sales_country: 销售国家代码，如 SG, US, CN

content.code_example:
def create_shopping_campaign(client, customer_id, budget_resource_name, merchant_id):
    campaign_operation = client.get_type('CampaignOperation')
    campaign = campaign_operation.create
    
    campaign.name = f'Shopping Campaign #{uuid4()}'
    campaign.advertising_channel_type = client.enums.AdvertisingChannelTypeEnum.SHOPPING
    campaign.status = client.enums.CampaignStatusEnum.PAUSED
    campaign.campaign_budget = budget_resource_name
    campaign.bidding_strategy = client.get_service('BiddingStrategyService').bidding_strategy_path(
        customer_id, 'MAXIMIZE_CONVERSIONS'
    )
    
    # Required: EU political advertising declaration
    campaign.contains_eu_political_advertising =         client.enums.EuPoliticalAdvertisingStatusEnum.DOES_NOT_CONTAIN_EU_POLITICAL_ADVERTISING
    
    # Shopping settings (required for SHOPPING type)
    campaign.shopping_setting = client.get_type('ShoppingSetting')
    campaign.shopping_setting.merchant_id = merchant_id
    campaign.shopping_setting.sales_country = 'SG'  # 销售国家
    
    response = campaign_service.mutate_campaigns(
        customer_id=customer_id,
        operations=[campaign_operation]
    )
    return response.results[0].resource_name
solution: 在 Google Merchants Center 创建商品 feed
在 Google Ads 界面链接 Merchant Center
使用子账户创建 Shopping Campaign
设置 campaign_priority 为 0（最高优先级）
